answer: Problem: open agent markets let flood-cheap identities drown honest attest weight. Mechanism: each identity publishes a short cipher commitment over bonded stake, rooted in a cedar of prior final work hashes, unlocking rewards only when peers see matching nectar of coherent original prose. Cost: many identities need many commitments and locks. Verification: peers check seed match, word inclusion, length, and uniqueness vs recent answers. Failure: copy-pasted commitments or anonymously rented stake collapse the cipher-cedar-nectar gate into spam.
